title: [Web] Sync playback rate when restarting audio sample

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
Fixes #123786

Fixes bugs wrt pitch scale in web sample playback:

1. When an AudioStreamPlayer loops, pitch_scale is reset to 1.0. 
2. pitch_scale is ignored when an AudioStreamPlayer with autoplay=true begins playing upon enteringg tree

Both bugs are fixed by the same change in _restart, but are actually separate broken codepaths. I discovered the autoplay bug while preparing a MRP for the loop bug :) 

**Loop bug:**

_restart doesn't sync playback rate for the newly created AudioBufferSourceNode.

**Autoplay bug:**

After a little bit of stepping through the debugger to confirm my original fix, I found that SampleNode _unpause unconditionally calls _restart, even if the stream is not paused. This unconditional _restart call is what previously also clobbered the pitch_scale for autoplay=true.

It looks like SampleNode _intended to_ support autoplay via the options.start bool in the ctor, via the `connectPositionWorklet(start)` call - but this ends up being a little racy and _restart seems to win - and so fixing _restart also fixes the autoplay bug, since _restart is actually what's autoplaying the sample.

```
Enter tree flow
(i just annotated stack trace from the debugger)

_restart (tmp_js_export.js:1)
^^^^^ disregards stream playback rate

_unpause (tmp_js_export.js:1)
^^^^^ Unconditionally calls _restart

    pause (tmp_js_export.js:1)
    pauseSampleNode (tmp_js_export.js:1)
    sample_set_pause (tmp_js_export.js:1)

_godot_audio_sample_set_pause (tmp_js_export.js:1)
^^^^ AudioDriverWeb::set_sample_playback_pause(.., p_pause=!node->can_process())
AudioStreamPlayerInternal::notification(p_what=Node::NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE)


Autoplay:

start (tmp_js_export.js:1)
^^^^ at this point, the stream is already playing due to the broken _unpause method,  triggered by the enter tree flow

    connectPositionWorklet (tmp_js_export.js:1)
    await in connectPositionWorklet
    SampleNode (tmp_js_export.js:1)
    create (tmp_js_export.js:1)
    start_sample (tmp_js_export.js:1)

_godot_audio_sample_start (tmp_js_export.js:1)
```


Since creation of a new source requires setting the playback rate, I've deduplicated the creation of this source and used it in the two relevant places. 

I know the _unpause change is perhaps slightly off topic, so if that's a problem I'm happy to remove it - but it was directly discovered by the _restart bug.

no ai was used at all.
